title: D3D: Decoupled Diffusion Drafting for Asynchronous Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.06425v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Target-conditioned diffusion drafters predict candidate tokens in parallel, yet each new block must wait for updated target-model hidden states. This forces drafting and verification to run sequentially, limiting speedup even though each block is generated in one pass. We introduce D3D, a standalone diffusion drafter that removes this inter-round dependency. D3D combines blockwise denoising with auxiliary autoregressive supervision to achieve long accepted prefixes without target hidden states. This independence lets D3D draft successor blocks during verification in one packed pass, enabling asynchronous speculative decoding. We progressively prune layers according to their effect on acceptance length to reduce the cost of packed drafting. Removing five of 36 layers retains over 99\% of mean acceptance length across three benchmarks with Qwen3-8B as the target. Across seven benchmarks, D3D averages 5.00$\times$ and 5.71$\times$ decoding

translated_title: D3D：面向异步投机解码的解耦扩散草稿生成
translated_abstract: 目标条件扩散草稿模型可以并行预测候选 token，但每个新块都必须等待目标模型更新后的隐藏状态。这迫使草稿生成与验证必须串行运行，即使每个块都是一次性生成，速度提升仍然受限。我们提出 D3D，一种独立的扩散草稿模型，消除了这种轮次间的依赖。D3D 将分块去噪与辅助自回归监督相结合，在不依赖目标模型隐藏状态的情况下实现较长的被接受前缀。这种独立性使 D3D 能够在验证过程中通过一次打包前向传递草拟后续块，从而实现异步投机解码。我们根据各层对接受长度的影响逐步剪枝，以降低打包草稿生成的成本。在以 Qwen3-8B 为目标模型的三个基准测试中，移除 36 层中的 5 层后，平均接受长度仍保持在 99% 以上。在七个基准测试中，D3D 平均实现了 5.00 倍和 5.71 倍的解码加速（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: D3D 提出一种不依赖目标模型隐藏状态的独立扩散草稿模型，使草稿生成与验证可异步并行执行，在多个基准上平均实现约 5 倍的解码加速。
en_tdlr: D3D introduces a standalone diffusion drafter that decouples drafting from target-model hidden states, enabling asynchronous speculative decoding and achieving an average of over 5x decoding speedup across multiple benchmarks.
